target.artifact: host-integrated live claim attempt receipt emitter

problem: Claim-attempt receipt schema, race fixtures and validator tests now exist, but the live create-if-absent worker claim flow has not demonstrated automatic persistence of real WON/LOST_EXISTING/HOST_ERROR outcomes. A losing GitHub claim race can still disappear with the worker chat, making actual collision-rate reconstruction depend on non-durable local errors.
acceptance: Real claim flow emits append-only CLAIM_ATTEMPT receipts for WON, LOST_EXISTING and HOST_ERROR based on actual host results.
LOST_EXISTING receipts resolve the winning claim ref and commit when observable and record no_overwrite_decision=true.
A live multi-worker canary produces durable receipts whose winner/loser counts reconcile with actual claims and failed attempts.
Receipt emission failure cannot change claim authority or overwrite outcome, and credential payloads are excluded.
title: Wire live claim-attempt receipts
mission: Implement and canary a host-integrated append-only CLAIM_ATTEMPT receipt emitter around real worker claim operations so collision evidence survives chat loss and the 50-worker stress verifier/control room can reconstruct actual races without trusting worker prose.

goal_relevance.reason: The universal-worker canary explicitly requires measurable collision/duplication behavior and durable evidence rather than chat-local prose.

information_gain.reason: Live claim-attempt receipts distinguish actual contention from static claim counts and make lost races reconstructable after worker disappearance.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Durable loser receipts remove any need for the human or a surviving chat transcript to report which claim races were lost.

regression_prevention.reason: The existing validator already encodes no-overwrite and winner-link invariants; wiring it to real host outcomes would let independent verifiers detect regressions rather than only validate fixtures.

falsification: A real two-worker create-if-absent race yields one winning claim but no durable loser CLAIM_ATTEMPT receipt.
A receipt writer can overwrite the winning claim or alter claim authority/outcome.
Winner/loser receipt counts cannot be reconciled against live claim attempts by an independent verifier.
Receipt payload contains credentials or private conversation content.
dedup_note: Existing active queues cover collision analysis, evidence schema/fixtures, allocator behavior and stress verification, but no inspected READY opportunity or live coordination/canary-evidence artifact demonstrates host-integrated emission of real claim-attempt receipts. This proposal is intentionally narrower than those lanes.
